explicit_unknowns: Slots 3, 4, 5, 6, and 9 record layouts inside base1 and normal2 remain open beyond pointer-table bounds.
Slot 10 sound/sequence binary record headers (0x060095E0 -> SCSP.RAM) remain open for RSAT-008.
Dynamic VDP2 plane destination selection for Slot 0 entries with default_dest=0x00000000 and Slot 2 tilemaps is driven by per-scene SH-2 callers rather than bank headers.

negative_controls.description: Compare normal2 (0x00254000..0x002e0000) against menu-release where openning occupies 0x00254000.
Compare normal1 (id=4) against resident normal2 (id=5) WorkRAML.
Decode real normal2 Slot 8 sb=3 block (0x0029f804) with contiguous 24-bit packing instead of 0x0603434C's 3-byte bit-planar reader.
Decode real normal2 Slot 7 stage grid #1 (0x0029453c, sm=1) with single 512-byte ring and with 2-element pair interleaving instead of 1-element stride-2 rings.
Mutate base1 Slot 0 #1 predictor code to 20 (>19) and truncate compressed payload to 24 bytes.
Flip 1 bit in resident WorkRAML+0x00100 and VDP2.VRAM+0x50010 and verify exact-match rejection.

capture_protocol.mechanism: Advance from accepted navigation-release-late (Attract Demo idx=2, normal1) across 6 bounded START skips so Title Screen timeout (0x06052E54, 0x0384 ticks -> 0x06052A00) steps *(u8*)0x060C17DA through 0x060B6BC0 to idx=12 ((1, 1) = Normal Game World 2 Stage 1), where 0x0600AF4C/0x0600AE58 transiently stages s_nor2 (bank_id=15) into SCSP.RAM and then loads normal2 (bank_id=5) into 0x00254000..0x002e0000 alongside resident base1 (bank_id=1).
